verdict.rationale: Aider is a local CLI coding agent. It consumes LLM provider keys and offers no hosted API or service of its own, so issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials to agents does not fit its product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships a credential-issuing capability, and the OpenAPI probes all return 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
